Cydney

messages.text:
To clarify - there are a few things happening/a couple of components here for emailing new and waitlisted users as part of the onboarding journey.

1. *`Waitlisted Email:`* When users create an account and are put on the waitlist, the ideal user experience is they get an email confirming they are on the list. <@U0AEL7C0BPB> I believe you are asking if we are already sending autoresponder messages to users when they are put on the waitlist, but <@U05BV05GYQH> you are confirming that is not currently happening at the moment. (I didn't think it was - but Mike let me know if you were told otherwise?)
2. `Welcome Email:`  For now, once we go to market I will manually send an email to users when they are OFF the waitlist. (This is why I need the list of users with their name, email, waitlist status, and date of joining). This removes the pressure of needing to get the email onboarding journey done before we start marketing. 
3. We want these emails to come from the info@sayso.news domain that you made recently <@U05BV05GYQH>. For the Welcome Emails, I just need access to the inbox in cerby. For the autoresponder Waitlist Emails - we'd need to discuss a. the priority of this and b. if there is a way to set this autoresponder up before we get to launch. I don't see a feasible way to do this manually, unfortunately.
